summary: KNOREX Ltd. reported via Form 6-K receipt of an NYSE American notice for failure to meet continued listing standards—specifically stockholders' equity minimums of $2.0M and $4.0M under Sections 1003(a)(i) and (ii). As of December 31, 2025, stockholders' deficit was $(6.5) million with four consecutive years of net losses. The company must submit a compliance plan by September 20, 2026 and regain compliance by February 21, 2028. Failure risks delisting. Listing remains active pending review. Watch plan acceptance and feasibility of regaining equity standards.
